name: P_pro / Money manager 1.0
summary: This EA automatically opens a sell position on every tick when no positions exist, then monitors open positions and closes them when profit or loss reaches a user-defined percentage of account balance, factoring in lot commissions and spread costs. P_pro adds the auto-entry sell logic while Money manager 1.0 only handles the closing logic. Both share identical profit/loss closing mechanisms based on account balance percentages.
summary_zh: 此EA在没有持仓时自动开仓卖出，然后监控持仓，当盈利或亏损达到用户设定的账户余额百分比时自动平仓，同时考虑了手数佣金和点差成本。P_pro版本增加了自动卖出入场逻辑，而Money manager 1.0仅处理平仓逻辑。两者共享基于账户余额百分比的盈亏平仓机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA的核心逻辑是基于账户余额百分比的盈亏管理工具，而非基于技术指标的趋势跟踪或动量策略。入场条件：P_pro版本在没有持仓时，每个tick都会自动以当前Bid价开仓卖出0.1手，缺乏任何技术分析信号或方向判断。出场条件：当持仓盈利达到(PD%×账户余额 + 佣金 + 点差)时平仓获利，当亏损达到(-(LD%×账户余额) - 佣金 - 点差)时平仓止损。仓位管理：固定手数0.1手，没有任何动态仓位调整或资金管理比例计算。资金管理：基于账户余额百分比设置盈亏阈值，同时将佣金和点差成本纳入计算，但Spread计算存在问题——ClosePosLoss中用Bid-Ask得到负值而非正确点差。整体策略缺乏方向性判断，纯粹是开仓后等待盈亏阈值触发的机械操作。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: The core logic is an account-balance-percentage-based profit/loss management utility rather than a technically-driven trend following or momentum strategy. Entry conditions: The P_pro variant automatically opens a 0.1-lot sell position at the current Bid price on every tick when no positions exist, with absolutely no technical analysis signal or directional judgment. Exit conditions: Positions are closed when profit reaches (PD% × account balance + commission + spread) or when loss reaches (-(LD% × account balance) - commission - spread). Position sizing: Fixed lot size of 0.1 lots with no dynamic position sizing or proportional money management calculation. Money management: Profit/loss thresholds are set based on account balance percentage with commission and spread costs factored in, but the spread calculation in ClosePosLoss is buggy — using Bid-Ask yields a negative value instead of the correct spread. The overall strategy lacks any directional analysis and is purely a mechanical operation of opening a position then waiting for profit/loss thresholds to trigger.

parameters.description: 是否启用盈利平仓功能

parameters.name: LossDeal
parameters.description: 是否启用亏损平仓功能

parameters.name: PD
parameters.description: 盈利平仓阈值（占账户余额百分比）
parameters.description_en: Profit close threshold as % of account balance

parameters.name: LD
parameters.description: 亏损平仓阈值（占账户余额百分比）
parameters.description_en: Loss close threshold as % of account balance

pros: 将佣金和点差成本纳入盈亏计算，提供了更真实的盈亏阈值
可灵活启用或禁用盈利/亏损平仓功能，具有一定的配置灵活性
使用账户余额百分比而非固定点数来设定阈值，能随资金变化自适应调整
循环遍历持仓时从后向前遍历，避免了删除元素时的索引错位问题
pros_en: Factors commission and spread costs into profit/loss calculations, providing more realistic thresholds
Allows flexible enabling or disabling of profit/loss closing functions with configurable toggles
Uses account balance percentage rather than fixed pip amounts for thresholds, enabling adaptive adjustment as capital changes
Iterates positions from back to front, avoiding index shift issues when closing positions during iteration
cons: ClosePosLoss中Spread计算错误：使用Bid-Ask而非Ask-Bid，导致点差值为负数，使亏损阈值计算失真
入场逻辑仅为无条件卖出，没有任何技术指标或方向判断，纯粹是盲目开仓
缺乏止损和止盈的订单级别设置，完全依赖程序运行时的tick检测来平仓，若EA断线则持仓无保护
手数固定为0.1手，没有根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整仓位
ClosePosLoss函数中有多余的花括号层级，代码结构混乱
没有新K线检测或时间过滤，每个tick都执行全部逻辑，可能造成不必要的性能开销
cons_en: Spread calculation bug in ClosePosLoss: uses Bid-Ask instead of Ask-Bid, producing a negative spread value that distorts the loss threshold calculation
Entry logic is an unconditional sell with no technical indicators or directional judgment — purely blind order opening
No order-level stop loss or take profit is set, relying entirely on tick-level monitoring; if the EA disconnects, positions have zero protection
Fixed lot size of 0.1 with no dynamic position sizing based on account balance or risk percentage
Extra unnecessary brace nesting in ClosePosLoss function, indicating messy code structure
No new bar detection or time filtering; all logic executes on every tick, potentially causing unnecessary performance overhead
improvements: 修复ClosePosLoss中的点差计算：应使用Ask-Bid而非Bid-Ask，确保点差为正值
为入场逻辑添加技术指标判断或方向性信号，而非无条件卖出
在开仓时设置订单级别的止损和止盈，作为EA断线时的安全网
添加动态仓位计算，根据账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
添加新K线检测机制，避免每个tick重复执行不必要的计算和检测
添加最大持仓数量限制和持仓时间限制，防止长时间暴露于市场风险中
improvements_en: Fix spread calculation in ClosePosLoss: should use Ask-Bid instead of Bid-Ask to ensure a positive spread value
Add technical indicator-based entry signals or directional judgment instead of unconditional selling
Set order-level stop loss and take profit when opening positions as a safety net when the EA is disconnected
Add dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and risk percentage
Add new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant calculations and checks on every tick
Add maximum position count limits and maximum holding time limits to prevent prolonged market risk exposure

risk_points: 入场逻辑为无条件卖出，没有任何方向判断，等同于随机方向交易
没有订单级别的止损止盈，EA断线时持仓完全无保护，可能造成远超LD%的亏损
点差计算Bug导致亏损平仓阈值不准确，可能延迟止损或过早止损
risk_points_en: Entry logic is an unconditional sell with no directional judgment, equivalent to random-direction trading
No order-level stop loss/take profit; if EA disconnects, positions are completely unprotected and losses can far exceed LD%
Spread calculation bug causes inaccurate loss-closing thresholds, potentially delaying or prematurely triggering stops

P_pro adds the auto-entry sell logic while Money manager 1.0 only handles the closing logic. Both share identical profit/loss closing mechanisms based on account balance percentages.
